name: Tarmogoyf Nest
oracle_text:
Enchant land
Enchanted land has "{1}{G}, {T}: Create a Tarmogoyf token." (It's a {1}{G} Lhurgoyf creature with "Tarmogoyf's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in all graveyards and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.")
blocked_sentences: Enchanted land has "{1}{G}, {T}: Create a Tarmogoyf token." (It's a {1}{G} Lhurgoyf creature with "Tarmogoyf's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in all graveyards and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1.")

needs.what: A named Tarmogoyf token: a green Lhurgoyf creature token named Tarmogoyf with mana cost {1}{G} (so mana value 2, 111.4 copy of a card's cost), base P/T 0/1, and the characteristic-defining static "Tarmogoyf's power is equal to the number of card types among cards in all graveyards and its toughness is equal to that number plus 1" -- a set_pt static (active in all zones) whose power is {"distinct": {"objects": {"zone": "graveyard", "controller": "any"}}} and toughness is {"sum": [that, {"const": 1}]}.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No token in token_ids is a Tarmogoyf or carries a card-types-in-graveyards P/T; the nearest x/x tokens (ooze_x_x_g, elemental_x_x_gw_creature_count) count other things, have no name 'Tarmogoyf' and no mana cost, so substituting one would change the token's P/T and mana value. The rest of the card is expressible today: Enchant land as an Aura target on a Land, the line as a grant_ability static with affects {enchanted_by: self} granting a grantable activated ability with cost {mana: {1}{G}, tap: true} and a create_token effect -- only the token id is missing. The static value `distinct` (Delirium) already counts card types among matched cards, so the token's CDA needs no engine work.
